meta.name: prisma-cli
meta.description: Prisma ORM CLI commands reference covering init, generate, migrate, db, dev, studio, validate, format, debug, and mcp. Use for ORM/database CLI workflows, not Prisma Compute app deployment. For Prisma Compute, `@prisma/cli app deploy`, `compute:deploy`, `create-prisma --deploy`, apps, deployments, logs, or domains, use the `prisma-compute` skill instead. Triggers on "prisma init", "prisma generate", "prisma migrate", "prisma db", "prisma studio", "prisma mcp".

copy.tagline: 用命令行管理数据库结构和迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在开发中常用 Prisma 命令行工具管理数据库。
copy.tagline_en: Manage database schemas and migrations from the command line.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly use Prisma CLI to manage your database in development.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会依据该技能提供 Prisma CLI 命令的使用说明,涵盖初始化、生成客户端、迁移、数据库操作、开发数据库、Studio 等,并告知 Prisma Compute 部署需用另一技能。
howto.when: 当你说出“prisma init”“prisma generate”等关键词,或要求初始化 Prisma 项目、生成客户端、管理数据库迁移时触发;涉及 Prisma Compute 部署时不适用。

say.text: 帮我初始化 Prisma 项目,数据库用 PostgreSQL
say.note: 会生成项目配置文件和 prisma/ 文件夹

say.text: 运行 prisma migrate dev,生成并应用迁移
say.note: 会创建并执行一次数据库迁移

say.text: 打开 prisma studio 查看数据
say.note: 会启动一个数据库图形界面

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude uses this skill to provide usage guidance for Prisma CLI commands, covering init, generate, migrate, db operations, dev, Studio, etc., and notes that Prisma Compute deployment should use another skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention keywords like "prisma init" or "prisma generate", or ask to initialize a Prisma project, generate the client, or manage database migrations. Not for Prisma Compute deployment.

say_en.text: Initialize a Prisma project with PostgreSQL
say_en.note: Creates the project config and prisma/ folder

say_en.text: Run prisma migrate dev to create and apply a migration
say_en.note: Creates and runs a database migration

say_en.text: Open prisma studio to view the data
